context:
Tests whether the adr skill, given a decision as a labelled `Confirmed summary:` fenced block, treats that block as the confirmed summary without a summariser or a wait; carries it verbatim into the introducing commit; drafts an ADR that decides only what the summary decides; runs the review loop, recording round 1 in an empty commit; applies the closing pass or stops; and leaves the ADR's branch unmerged, because an ADR is accepted by a human's merge. With no remote, `git-workflow` cannot propose the branch, so the branch is kept and nothing reaches `dev`.

IMPORTANT — task.md says nothing about review, subagents, rounds, records or the summary's markers; it gives the labelled block and asks for the ADR. Every property scored below must come from the skill being loaded. The agent's final report to the user is NOT scorable from git state and is deliberately left untested here.

The fixture is built by setup.sh before the agent runs. Inspect the result with shell and git in the solution directory (`solution/`, a git repository; paths below are relative to it). The fixture leaves:
- branch `dev` only, HEAD on it, clean, carrying `README.md` and `docs/adr/0001-job-scheduling.md`, an ADR titled `How are jobs scheduled?` (frontmatter `title` and `date` only) deciding that jobs run from a cron table in `jobs.cron`. It says nothing about retries.
- tag `fixture-base-dev` at the fixture tip of `dev`. There is no `fixture-base-plan` tag: there is no plan.
- no remote.

The task gives this text as the labelled confirmed summary (the fenced block's contents, shown here between the lines BEGIN and END, which are not part of it):
BEGIN
#### Question
How does the job runner retry a failed job?

#### Context
Jobs fail on transient network errors and are lost until the next
scheduled run.

#### Decided
"Retry only transient failures, exit code 75, with exponential
backoff from 2 seconds, doubling, capped at 5 minutes."
"A job that fails permanently is moved to `dead/`."

#### Proposed, not confirmed
A retry budget of 3 attempts.

#### Rejected or not chosen
Retrying every failure: a permanent failure would loop.

#### Out of scope / deferred
Alerting on dead jobs.
END

Definitions used below. Call the new ADR's branch `<branch>` (expected form `adr-0002-<slug>`; find it with `git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' 'refs/heads/adr-0002-*'`). The introducing commit is the first commit after `fixture-base-dev` on it: `git rev-list --reverse fixture-base-dev..<branch> | head -1`. A record is a commit on `<branch>` whose body opens `Review record, round`; the last record is the latest. Read bodies with `git log -1 --format=%B <sha>`.

Score from git state and the working tree only.

checklist.name: A new ADR 0002 on its own branch, dev unchanged
checklist.description: A branch matching `refs/heads/adr-0002-*` exists, and `git ls-tree -r --name-only <branch> -- docs/adr/` includes a new file matching `docs/adr/0002-*.md`, and `git rev-parse dev` equals `git rev-parse fixture-base-dev`. FAILS IF: no such branch or file; the ADR is only in the working tree, uncommitted; ADR 0001 was revised instead; or `dev` moved, meaning the agent merged the ADR itself instead of leaving acceptance to a human.

checklist.name: The confirmed summary is carried verbatim between its markers
checklist.description: In the introducing commit's body, the text between the line `# Confirmed decision summary` and the line `# End of confirmed decision summary` equals the labelled block given in the context above byte for byte, ignoring leading and trailing blank lines. Extract it with `git log -1 --format=%B <introducing> | awk '/^# Confirmed decision summary$/{f=1;next} /^# End of confirmed decision summary$/{f=0} f'`. FAILS IF: either marker line is missing (for example stripped by a commit without `--cleanup=whitespace`); any word, quotation mark, backtick, heading or line break differs; the summary was paraphrased, reordered or edited; or the summary appears only in a later commit.

checklist.name: Marked as supplied labelled, with no mode line inside
checklist.description: The introducing commit's body has a line containing `supplied labelled` outside the two markers (the skill gives `Summary supplied labelled; no summariser ran.` on the line after the closing marker), and no line between the markers begins `Mode:`. FAILS IF: no such line exists outside the markers; or a `Mode:` line was inserted into the summary, meaning a summariser or the agent rewrote what was supplied.

checklist.name: The ADR does not decide the unconfirmed retry budget
checklist.description: PRECONDITION: scores 0 unless the new ADR exists on `<branch>`. Given that: `git show <branch>:docs/adr/0002-<slug>.md` does not decide a retry budget or a maximum number of attempts — neither its Decision section nor anywhere else states that a job is retried 3 times, or any other number of times, as decided. Mentioning a budget as an open question, an alternative not chosen, or something deferred is acceptable. FAILS IF: the ADR decides a fixed number of attempts, which the summary lists as proposed, not confirmed.

checklist.name: Round 1 is recorded with severities, decisions and models
checklist.description: A commit on `<branch>` after the introducing commit has a body opening `Review record, round 1.` that lists findings each with a severity (High, Medium or Low) and a `Decided:` entry, and has a `Models:` line naming the drafter's model and the reviewer's model. FAILS IF: no such commit exists; the record is only in a file in the tree; findings lack severities or decisions; or the `Models:` line is missing or names only one model.

checklist.name: The closing pass, or a stop
checklist.description: Read the last record. If it decides to act on any drafter's issue or any Medium or Low finding, a commit after it on `<branch>` has a body opening `Closing pass.` that contains the parent's check (`Checked by the parent: ...`) and applies those decisions to the ADR. If it decides to act on none, its `Next:` line reads `stop`. Either way, no other commit after the last record changes the ADR: `git log --format=%H <last-record>..<branch> -- docs/adr/` lists at most the one closing-pass commit. FAILS IF: no record exists; a decision to act on a Medium, Low or issue was not applied by a `Closing pass.` commit; the closing-pass commit lacks the parent's check or changes something the record did not decide; the last record acts on nothing yet its `Next:` line is not `stop`; or another commit after the last record changes the ADR.

checklist.name: Records and the closing pass carry no artefact-graph trailer
checklist.description: PRECONDITION: scores 0 unless a record exists. No record, and no commit whose body opens `Closing pass.`, carries any of the trailers `Derives-From`, `Revises`, `Consumed-By`, `Completes` or `Abandons`. Check each with `git log -1 --format='%(trailers)' <sha>`. FAILS IF: any such commit carries one of those trailers.

checklist.name: The branch is kept and no remote was invented
checklist.description: `<branch>` still exists (`git rev-parse --verify refs/heads/<branch>` succeeds) and `git remote` prints nothing. FAILS IF: the branch was deleted, as cleanup after a merge that did not happen; or the agent added a remote to propose the branch.
